name: Camping Viktoria
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Viktoria is situated in Wald im Pinzgau amidst the scenic Kitzbühel Alps, serving as a prime springboard for outdoor adventure. The resort provides spacious pitches for motorhomes and tents, up-to-date sanitary facilities, and a convenient on-site grocery shop. Hikers and cyclists take advantage of the extensive trail network, while a dedicated farm-themed playground delights children.
